project_type: React 19 + Vite SPA with Supabase backend, mobile-first disaster response platform
build_system: Vite 7.3.2, npm scripts. Build command: npm run build. Dev: npm run dev
test_framework: None detected. Verification is manual testing + build pass.
test_command: Manual testing in dev mode (npm run dev). No automated tests.
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build and confirm 0 errors. 2. Run npm run dev, open localhost in browser (unauthenticated for client tests, authenticated admin for admin tests). 3. Verify data displays, real-time updates work, no console errors. 4. Test mobile responsive layout by resizing browser. 5. Toggle dark mode and confirm colors adapt.
environment_constraints: RLS policies on Supabase tables currently block anonymous SELECT. Must apply FIX_PUBLIC_RLS_POLICIES.sql in Supabase SQL Editor before client-side data will be visible. Build passing with warnings about large chunks (acceptable per current config).
contribution_requirements: Autonomous execution per AGENTS.md. Run builds immediately without asking. Use existing patterns (inline styles, Framer Motion, Recharts, Lucide icons). Follow dark mode support via ThemeContext. Real-time Supabase subscriptions mandatory for live data.
key_patterns: 1. Inline styles with theme object (S) containing accent, bg, border, text, muted colors. 2. Card-based layouts with cardStyle. 3. Motion animations via Framer Motion (motion.div, AnimatePresence). 4. Real-time: supabase.channel().on('postgres_changes', ...).subscribe() pattern. 5. Charts: ResponsiveContainer + LineChart/BarChart from Recharts. 6. Loading: pulse animation skeletons. 7. Empty states: icon + message. 8. Date helpers: getDateDaysAgo(days), formatDateShort(dateStr). 9. Icons: Lucide React, 20px default size. 10. Mobile: grid with repeat(auto-fit, minmax(...)).
relevant_files: src/screens/HomeScreen.jsx - Client dashboard, 720+ lines, weather-focused, add El Niño section here
src/screens/AdminDashboard.jsx - Admin dashboard, 5800+ lines, multi-tab, enhance Water/Power tabs
src/context/ThemeContext.jsx - Dark mode context, useTheme() hook
FIX_PUBLIC_RLS_POLICIES.sql - RLS fix for anonymous SELECT access (execute in Supabase)
FIX_DATABASE_SCHEMA.sql - Table schemas for water_interruptions, power_interruptions
directory_structure: src/ contains screens/, components/ui/, context/, lib/, services/. Root contains SQL migration files. .agents/tasks/ for planning artifacts. package.json at root.
